column1: # ZAP scan rule suppressions for university-ecosystem
# Format: ruleId
# See: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/docker/full-scan/#configuration-file
# 10015: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header Set
# Our API responses intentionally omit Cache-Control — controlled per-endpoint

column3: API responses use per-endpoint cache headers

column1: # 10017: Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion
# CDN assets (fonts, icons) are intentionally loaded from external origins

column3: CDN assets loaded via SRI-validated links

column1: # 10027: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
# Development source maps are disabled in production (MOD-P0-05)

column3: Source maps disabled in production builds

column1: # 10054: Cookie without SameSite Attribute
# Our HttpOnly session cookies include SameSite=Lax; ZAP false-positive on dev
# 10055: CSP, sub-alert 10055-6 (style-src 'unsafe-inline') only
# Owner-approved 2026-11-21 (ADR-047): accepted risk. rules.tsv matches a rule,
# not a sub-alert, so the rule stays enabled here. The scan hook
# (scripts/quality/zap_origin_evidence.py) lowers only 10055-6 to low, and only
# while the policy keeps the exact approved style-src directive.
# 10063: Feature Policy Header Not Set
# Superseded by Permissions-Policy; ZAP still checks deprecated header name

column3: Permissions-Policy header is set; Feature-Policy deprecated

column1: # 10106: HTTP Only Site
# Owner-approved 2026-11-19 (ADR-047): the ephemeral CI DAST stand is served
# over loopback HTTP without TLS, so this rule describes the test stand, not the
# product. Production terminates TLS in Caddy and sends HSTS.

column3: CI DAST stand is loopback HTTP; production terminates TLS

column1: # 10202 and 20012: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens / Anti-CSRF Tokens Check
# Owner-approved 2026-11-21 (ADR-047): forms marked data-csrf="header" are
# submitted by script with the double-submit token in a header. The scan sets
# rules.csrf.ignore.attname and attvalue (scripts/quality/zap_runner.py), so
# ZAP reports those forms as informational. Unmarked forms stay medium.
# 40012: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
# Trusted Types enforcement (MOD-W4) prevents XSS even without header-level block

column3: Review XSS findings manually against Trusted Types policy

column1: # 40014: Cross Site Scripting (Persistent)
# 40026: Cross Site Scripting (DOM Based)
# Owner-approved 2026-11-16 (ADR-047, expires 2027-01-10): the rule's headless
# browsers never finish, so the active scan cannot complete. In the full scan,
# IGNORE also stops the active rule from running. Trusted Types enforcement
# (require-trusted-types-for 'script') blocks DOM sinks in the browser.

column3: DOM XSS sinks are blocked by enforced Trusted Types

column1: # 90022: Application Error Disclosure
# Health endpoints expose partial service state intentionally

column3: Health endpoints expose service state by design
